Internal product/foundry profit shifts are distinguished from additional consolidated earnings. The margin sensitivity is conditioned on real group profit after production costs; no allegation of an established duplicate current-model credit is made.
Separate vendor throughput scenarios remain conditional. No original workload, interview,AMD performance advantage or direct chip-margin implication is claimed.
